crossRefs.note: The second took her, and died, leaving no children behind him. The third likewise;

parallels.note: The third took her, and likewise the seven all left no children, and died.

translations.web: The second took her, and died, leaving no children behind him. The third likewise;
translations.bsb: Then the second one married the widow, but he also died and left no children. And the third did likewise.
translations.kjv: And the second took her, and died, neither left he any seed: and the third likewise.
translations.asv: and the second took her, and died, leaving no seed behind him; and the third likewise:
